description: Polite, reasonable HR answers that stay generic.

messages.text: Why do you want to join us?
I want to work on payments because I enjoyed that at my internship, and your company is growing fast so I think I'll learn a lot.
I sometimes take too long perfecting things. I'm working on it by setting time limits for myself, though I still slip sometimes.
Are you open to relocating to Bengaluru?
Yes, I'm open to relocating, I'd just need a couple of weeks' notice to arrange things.
Where do you see yourself in five years?
I'd like to be a strong backend engineer, maybe leading a small team, but I'm mostly focused on learning for now.
Thanks, that's all from me. The team will be in touch.
